requirements.requirement: The system must include a prescription_behavior object in the provider evaluation response payload when backend RX data is available.
The system must ensure the prescription_behavior object conforms to the data contract defined in EVAL-P-RX-UX-S1.
The system must attach the prescription_behavior object to the correct provider entity within the chat response payload.
The system must propagate prescription_behavior data through evaluate_care_facade.py without altering semantic values from the backend service.
The system must ensure the chat response includes a module identifier or flag enabling frontend detection of the prescription behavior component.
The system must allow the frontend to detect the presence of prescription_behavior data and trigger rendering logic in MessageBubble.
The system must not include the prescription_behavior object in the payload when no RX data exists for the provider.
The system must return a valid chat response payload even if prescription_behavior data retrieval fails.
The system must log an error event when prescription_behavior data fails to integrate into the response payload.
The system must preserve backward compatibility so that existing provider evaluation responses render correctly without prescription_behavior data.
The system must ensure that inclusion of prescription_behavior data does not increase response latency beyond acceptable thresholds defined for evaluate care responses.
The system must serialize prescription_behavior data in a JSON-safe format compatible with frontend parsing.
